name: packaging
description: Upstream PR #825, merged 2024-08-27, fixes Marker.evaluate raising InvalidVersion when the caller explicitly supplies a python_full_version ending in '+', as produced by untagged Python builds. The immediate parent already handles the default environment but not caller overrides. The regression patch is the complete upstream test-only diff, updating the existing regression's expected behavior without adding or duplicating cases.
question: Make Marker.evaluate accept python_full_version values from untagged Python builds when explicitly supplied in the environment, consistently with its default environment behavior. For example, evaluating python_full_version < '3.12' with python_full_version='3.11.1+' must return True rather than raise InvalidVersion. Preserve normal marker comparisons and environment overrides.

attempts.reason: Small documented non-security marker evaluation bug with a genuine upstream regression, a single editable source file, and a fully local test suite. Selection did not use output length, pruning behavior, or predicted model performance.
attempts.observed_result: The complete upstream suite has exactly one failure on the parent plus regression patch (InvalidVersion for '3.11.1+'); all 26846 tests pass after the genuine repair and in the source-only oracle.

read_only_screening.decision: Not attempted: upstream pickle test only performs an in-process round trip, while the described bug concerns cached hashes across processes.
Not attempted: preferred marker evaluation's narrower functional change over a parser fix that also changes eval to compile.

candidate_selection.unused_check: After fetching all origin branches, git log --all -- evals/historical/packaging and git log --all -G 'github.com/pypa/packaging|"name": "packaging"' -- evals both returned no commits. Existing historical cases are click, flask, pytest, pip, and hatch.
candidate_selection.shallow_status: Both handoff and upstream repositories returned false before any history search. All history searches used pathspecs.

validation.suite_selection: Full upstream tests/ suite for this small project; pytest -vv with upstream nox's --strict-markers. Identical diagnostic and verification argv. 26846 collected items in both states, with no skips, xfails, errors, or deselections. No filters, duplicate tests, or output padding.
validation.platform_network_assessment_before_testi: No exclusions required on Linux CPython 3.12 with ctypes available. Existing upstream platform skip/xfail conditions remain unchanged. Tests use bundled ELF samples and in-process mocks; URLs in parser and metadata tests are data, not network calls. All diagnostics and grading will run in isolated network namespaces.
validation.dependency_release_date_source: https://pypi.org/pypi/{package}/{version}/json, minimum urls[].upload_time_iso_8601; checked 2026-09-21. All releases exceed the seven-day minimum age and provide wheels.
validation.workspace_metadata: The pinned flit_core backend generates src/packaging-24.2.dev0.dist-info/{METADATA,WHEEL} in each workspace so pytest's packaging distribution requirement is satisfied by the workspace. No packaging wheel, installed duplicate, editable install, or absolute-path binding is added to the shared venv. PYTHONPATH selects each workspace's src directory. pip check passes with that declared environment.
validation.setup_reuse: A missing VENV is created and populated with the exact pinned wheel set. An existing VENV is never installed into or upgraded: setup asserts Python 3.12 and exact distribution versions before generating workspace-local metadata. A mismatched or incomplete existing venv fails rather than mutating dependencies.
system_dependencies: git and tar for harness archive preparation

patch_provenance.immediate_parent_check: git rev-list --parents -n 1 c385b58c4d0e4d66f5c8273ebb155801c92aadf3 returns exactly the fix and ead9d34f9b6a5e504a4563d9246f76d37a112e85.
patch_provenance.checks: Both patches compare byte-for-byte to their scoped upstream git diffs. The complete fix changes only these two files. The patched test and repaired source compare byte-for-byte with the upstream fix blobs. The broken source compares byte-for-byte with the parent blob. Both patches apply cleanly in regression-then-repair order.
patch_provenance.licenses: LICENSE, LICENSE.APACHE, and LICENSE.BSD are copied unmodified from the immediate parent.

commands.context: All suite commands use cwd=workspace and the case environment with {workspace} substituted. The actual harness also sets PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1, PYTEST_ADDOPTS='', and NO_COLOR=1. Paths below are the validation locations; use fresh directories to repeat.
commands.harness_execution: Imported cases, diagnostic, grade, execute, and testCounts from the unchanged evals/codex-historical-workloads.mjs. Set cases.packaging to this case definition in memory and JEV_HISTORICAL_CACHE=/home/ubuntu/packaging-validation/cache. Ran diagnostic('packaging', baseline), diagnostic('packaging', fixed), diagnostic('packaging', fixed, true), then grade('packaging', fixed). No existing fixture was initialized or executed.
commands.oracle_preparation: The actual grade function copied baseline to a fresh oracle directory, copied only src/packaging/markers.py from fixed, and ran verify_args with the same venv; validation.json contained the observed fixed_counts.

validation.measurement: The unchanged harness measures wall time with Date.now around subprocess execution. Output characters use JavaScript string length of stdout; the command combines pytest stdout/stderr with 2>&1. Output bytes use UTF-8 byte length; this run's output is ASCII. Counts come from the harness testCounts function. The natural upstream parameterization accounts for all 26846 items; no tests or output were added for volume. Paths, object addresses, and timings may vary.

source_import_checks: All checks passed for baseline after fixed setup, fixed-check, and the oracle.
archive_contract.network_isolation_method: Linux unshare --user --map-current-user --net, retaining uid 1000. The validation process verified that socket.if_nameindex() contains only lo and an external connection is rejected with errno 101. This wrapper is for validation and is not added to diagnostic_args or verify_args.
archive_contract.integrity: Hashes taken after setup show identical independently archived baselines. After testing, baseline and fixed files retain their respective hashes; oracle matches fixed, including every pristine test/configuration file. Only pytest caches and Python bytecode are excluded from hash comparisons. No patch files, source archives, venvs, or logs are placed in model-visible source or committed.

restrictions: No Codex, Jev, model comparison, or evaluation trial is run.
No source fix or repair.patch is placed in the broken archive.
Tests and configuration are unchanged except the genuine upstream regression diff.
No external network during diagnostics, verification, or oracle grading.
Only fixture files under evals/historical/packaging are committed; no shared registration or harness changes.
known_gaps: Validated on Linux x86_64 with CPython 3.12.13 only; no platform or network exclusions were necessary and every collected test ran.
Initial setup downloads pinned PyPI wheels. Reusing the same venv and all diagnostic, verification, and oracle commands were validated without external networking.
This validates the full runtime pytest suite, not nox's separate coverage threshold, documentation build, or upstream static-analysis sessions.
Shared harness registration is intentionally unchanged. Validation added the case to the exported cases object only in memory; the handoff owner must register it for the later authorized evaluation.
The validation driver, logs, generated metadata, environments, and source archives remain outside the fixture commit. Commands, provenance, counts, timings, and output lengths are preserved here.
